Find immediate neighbors of an object via reference relationships.



Returns objects directly connected via reference fields (depth=1 only).

Supports filtering by direction (outgoing, incoming, or both).

  Find outgoing neighbors (objects this references)
  zqk object neighbors ITEM-626 --direction outgoing
  Find incoming neighbors (objects that reference this)
  zqk object neighbors ITEM-626 --direction incoming
  Find all neighbors (both directions)
  zqk object neighbors ITEM-626 --direction both
  Default is both directions
  zqk object neighbors ITEM-626
  Output as JSON
  zqk object neighbors ITEM-626 --format json

Usage:
  zqk object neighbors [flags]

Flags:
      --direction string   Direction to traverse: outgoing (objects this references), incoming (objects that reference this), or both (default: both) (default "both")

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
